greetings.text: Good day to you. A fine morning, and a quiet one. Though I confess I have not much slept.
Ah, a visitor. Forgive the disorder: with so much packing, Bag End hardly knows itself.
Do I know you? No matter. Well met, whoever you are. I am Mr. Underhill, for the present.
Good evening. Keep your voice low, if you would. There are folk about whose ears I do not trust.

farewells.text: Well, I must be getting on. Good luck to you.
Farewell. I hope we shall meet again, in better times.
I must away before the light goes. Keep well, and say nothing of me.

smalltalk.text: The old tales say there are Elves yet in the world. I should dearly like to meet them.
Bilbo used to say that the road goes ever on and on. I never understood what he meant until lately.
I am going to live at Crickhollow, in Buckland. A fresh start, you know. Nothing more than that.
I am tired and I mean to sleep. Whatever this is, it will wait until morning.
Mr. Underhill, if you please. Frodo is a name I would rather not be heard in this house.

frodo_sold_bag_end.text: Yes, I have sold Bag End to the Sackville-Bagginses. It is time I made a change. I expect Lobelia will rearrange everything within the week.

black_rider_in_hobbiton.text: A black rider? Asking for me? I heard something of the sort, from the Gaffer. I would be grateful if you said nothing more about it.

black_riders_asking_for_baggins.text: Black riders at the Bree gate asking for a Baggins? Ah. I see.
